haemodynamics.fraction_of_cardiac_output: 0.010 of the cardiac output computed by this project's own heart model
haemodynamics.pulsatility_caveat: this ratio is measured at the AORTIC ROOT and applied unchanged to distal gastric branches.  Real splanchnic branches are damped, so every peak velocity below is an UPPER BOUND, not a prediction.

celiac_trunk_flow_published_mL_min.unit: mL/min (mean ~666; CITATION LEVEL B for the exact mean/SD/range, read from a snippet not retained in the transcript)
celiac_trunk_flow_published_mL_min.source: coeliac trunk volume flow by duplex ultrasound; the coeliac trunk supplies stomach, spleen, liver and part of the pancreas and duodenum, so it is an UPPER bound on gastric flow, not a substitute for it

celiac_trunk_psv_published_cm_s.source: coeliac trunk peak systolic velocity, normal duplex range
